title: Indiana National Guard Drawsdown from Tornado Support
description: Indiana National Guard drawsdown from providing support to community after tornado devastation. U.S. Senators for Indiana Dan Coats and Dick Lugar give interviews as well as Indiana Adjutant General, Maj. Gen. R. Martin Umbarger. Also available in high definition
keywords: Indiana National Guard, tornado, natural disaster, state active duty, Dick Lugar, Dan Coats, High Definition, Senator, Umbarger
